description: This Java class 'RetrieveFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl' is an immutable implementation of a command object used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the logic for retrieving a specific feature property in a live query context, extending an abstract base class and implementing a command interface.
